TS048 main-first

The entry point comes first in the file, so a reader meets the top of the call graph before its parts.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: info
default: opt-in
group: stable

TigerStyle: "_Order_ matters for readability (even if it doesn't affect semantics). On the first read, a file is read top-down, so put important things near the top. The `main` function goes first."
